name: Maintain
oneLiner: Send a new idea back to Plan as a change request.
goal: Real use starts the lifecycle again. A new idea does not land inside the current change.

steps.title: Notice the new idea
steps.text: Name what real use showed, separate from the change that is already open.

steps.title: Write the change request
steps.text: Fill the change-request template. Leave the current change alone.

steps.title: Re-enter at Plan
steps.text: The next step is a new plan. Do not implement the idea here.

doneChecks.text: The new idea is a change request, separate from the current change.

pitfalls.text: Implementing the new idea inside the change that is already open.

optionGroups.label: How to continue
optionGroups.help: What happens to a new idea after the change ships?

options.label: Change request
options.detail: Write it down and start again at Plan.
options.promptFragment: Treat this as maintenance. Write a change request and re-enter at Plan. Do not implement the new idea in the current change.
